title: yaks blob keyword vocabulary
description: The keyword @yaks/blob adds to a component vocabulary. A string column declaring `store: "blob"` keeps its value in a content-addressed store instead of in the row: the row holds the value's hash, the store holds the bytes, and both the write and the read go through unchanged — a writer sends text and a reader gets text back.
$comment: A vocabulary declaration in the JSON Schema sense: a URI naming this keyword set, plus the schema of each keyword. A vocab file declares it under $vocabulary; a loader registers it with loadVocab(docs, [blobKeywords]).

store.description: Where this column's value is kept. "blob" moves it to a content-addressed store, keyed by the SHA-256 of the text — so two rows holding the same long value hold one copy of it. The column stays an ordinary string column everywhere else: it is declared, queried and written as text.
